screen: Review — three directions on Northside's own file
job: A ledger of what is wrong with the dealer's own price file, each finding with a priced fix that writes to the real file as one undoable step. Drawn on the true day-one state, measured 2026-10-22: lintProject on loadPack() gives 142 marks on 53 lists (4 twin column names, 3 lists with nameless rows, and 135 tidy marks: 108 free text, 10 plural names, 8 lists inside lists, 7 unlinked, 2 repeating), and not one carries a dollar. The checks that cost money are outside the linter: atmBandDisagreements tests 430 trailers and finds 9 in the wrong band (7 small-but-heavy, $819 not charged; 2 large-but-light, $234 charged over); 25 names carry two prices (17 parts, 6 Helm Master EX dealer fits, 2 Mackay trailers; widest $1,899 and $2,890); 185 live rows sell at $0 on 5 lists (86 are Parts' Labour Estimates; 47 held-back rows are not counted; Haines Signature's 9 are packages); 10 rows have no name. 233 findings touch a price or a pick. No photography: the picture is the file. Every board uses the app's day tokens, copied from src/styles/tokens.css.

directions.name: A · Reconcile — the file beside the fix
directions.axis: Full-width mirrored rows, grouped by check under three bands (Money, A wrong pick, Tidy). The first money check is open: each of the 9 trailers stands as the file reads it on the left and as it would read on the right, with Re-band in a gutter between; the corrected Sell inc Rego and the +$117 a sale are said before anything is written. The other checks are one counted line each; tidy is one folded line of 135.
directions.only: It shows the corrected cell beside the dealer's own before anything is written, with what the fix does to a customer's price.

directions.name: B · The marked file — the whole file, drawn
directions.axis: A canvas: the 53 lists as tiles grouped by kind (pairings, parts, boats, motors, trailers, fees, packages), each sized by the square root of its rows, with every money finding painted as a dot at its row and every pick as a ring or an edge bar. A rail says what the marks mean, with an eye per kind (tidy hidden) and what was checked and true. GFAB is selected; its callout names the four Sportskis and the act.
directions.only: It shows the whole price file at once and where it is wrong, so 8,679 clean pairings and one dense block of $0 parts are seen in one look.

directions.name: C · The tally — every check, with figures that move
directions.axis: A scoreboard: one row per check, each said as the sentence that will be true when it is clean, ordered by what it costs, with Found · Fixed today · Left as meant · Left as tall tabular figures. The $0 check is open, its 185 rows grouped by the one press that clears several (Leave the 86 Labour Estimates as meant). Tidy sits under a rule in quieter rows.
directions.only: It counts the file's health as figures that move while the dealer fixes, and keeps every check on the clean day, its sentence true and Left at 0.
